resources.string: Plug the Kobo into this device with a USB-C data cable.
On the Kobo\'s screen, tap Connect.
The first time only, allow KoLib to use the Kobo\'s drive.
Kobo found. Tap Connect on its screen.
Android opens its folder picker on the Kobo\'s drive. Tap “Use this folder”, then “Allow”.
KoLib couldn\'t open the Kobo. Unplug it, plug it in again, and try again.
No Kobo with you? Skip this. You can connect it any time from the Kobo tab.
KoLib can put your books into collections on the Kobo, but it can\'t make new collections there. Make the collection on the Kobo first, and then KoLib can add books to it.
On the Kobo, go to My Books, then Collections, and tap New collection.
Add books any time with the Add books button, and send them to your Kobo when it\'s plugged in.
